goal.objective: Activate the canonical StegVerse-Labs/.github single-heartbeat runtime continuously on a correctly owned replaceable always-on host whose writable SHWP state survives restart and deploy without transferring heartbeat scheduling authority to the host provider.
success_predicates: A dedicated or already-owned compliant long-lived process host is durably identified for StegVerse-Labs/.github
Required recurring infrastructure cost and provisioning authority are durably approved where applicable
Heartbeat, registry, event, cost, receipt and canonical-checkpoint state survive process restart/deploy
The host starts scripts/run_heartbeat_runtime.py --continuous while runtime v8 owns internal cadence
A restart-continuity proof preserves or increments the one heartbeat epoch and creates no duplicate claim or fence
No ChatGPT automation, GitHub schedule, Render cron or equivalent external scheduler owns worker activation
failure_predicates: A paid or recurring-cost resource is provisioned without durable authority
An LLM-adapter, StegVerse-SCW or other subsystem resource is appropriated without an authority transfer
A stateless or sleeping host is presented as durable always-on activation
A third-party scheduler becomes the normative heartbeat cadence or worker activation authority
Restart/deploy loses or forks canonical heartbeat, registry, event, cost, receipt or checkpoint state

task.derivation_reason: Protocol implementation, validation, read surfaces and recovery semantics are complete; the only remaining activation dependency is infrastructure/procurement authority for a compliant durable always-on host.

activation.recheck_trigger: boundaries/SHWP-DURABLE-RUNTIME-ACTIVATION.json status becomes RESOLVED with a durable resolution_ref and separate deployment authorization is admitted

completion.next_authorized_action: No deployment or spend is authorized. Await a durable human-authority resolution identifying/approving a compliant host; then create a separate bounded deployment authorization and execute restart-continuity proof.
terminal_when: The dedicated compliant host is active with durable SHWP state
Parent StegVerse-Labs/.github#12 activation predicates are all satisfied
